data: Is the shaded area in the bottom left subplot mostly green?

The bottom left subplot is the one we need to focus on. The blue areas represent instances where clickbait posts receive more attention than non-clickbait posts, while the green areas represent instances where non-clickbait posts receive more attention than clickbait posts. 

Looking at the bottom left subplot, the majority of the shaded area appears to be green, indicating that non-clickbait posts generally receive more attention than clickbait posts in this section. Therefore, the answer to the question is yes, the shaded area in the bottom left subplot is mostly green.
